About the job

Harwick Components SE is a family-owned supplier of precision drive and sensor components for the automotive, agricultural and medical technology industries. Founded in 1961 in a small workshop in Franconia, we have grown into a group of 23 companies with 4,700 employees at 17 sites in Europe, North America and Asia and generated revenues of EUR 1.1 billion in the last financial year.

Our owners think in generations, not in quarters. That is why we invest heavily in our sites, our people and the digital backbone of the group. Over the past three years we have moved 14 of our 23 entities to SAP S/4HANA, set up a shared service centre in Brno and started to rebuild our planning landscape from scratch.

We are now looking for a Head of Group Controlling who wants to shape the next chapter of this journey together with our CFO.

Why this role matters

Group Controlling is the analytical heart of Harwick. The team of 12 controllers in Nuremberg and Brno supports the Executive Board, the three business units and the regional management teams with reliable figures, sound analyses and clear recommendations. With the ongoing shift of our product portfolio towards electrified drivetrains and medical applications, the demands on transparency, speed and forward-looking steering are higher than ever.

You will report directly to the CFO and will be a permanent guest in the monthly Executive Board meetings.

What you will do
- Lead, develop and inspire the Group Controlling team (12 FTE across two locations) and act as a role model for a feedback-driven, collaborative leadership culture
- Own the group-wide planning cycle including the annual budget, the three-year mid-term plan and two rolling forecasts per year
- Further develop the management reporting for the Executive Board, the Supervisory Board and our owners, including a meaningful KPI set for all business units
- Drive the rollout of SAP Analytics Cloud for planning and reporting together with IT and the business unit controllers
- Steer investment controlling, including the evaluation of capex projects above EUR 2 million and post-investment reviews
- Support M&A projects with business cases, valuations and integration controlling
- Harmonise controlling processes, cost centre structures and allocation logic across all entities
- Work closely with Group Accounting on the monthly and quarterly close and the reconciliation between internal and external reporting under IFRS
- Act as sparring partner for the business unit CFOs and the regional managing directors

What we offer
- A key position with genuine room for manoeuvre in a financially strong, family-owned group
- Short decision paths and direct access to the CFO, the Executive Board and our shareholders
- An attractive package: base salary of EUR 145,000 to 165,000 plus an annual bonus of up to 25 % of the base salary, linked to group and personal targets
- Company car from the executive fleet, also for private use, or a mobility budget
- Company pension scheme with a 50 % employer top-up
- Up to two days of mobile work per week and flexible working hours
- 30 days of annual leave plus 24 and 31 December off
- Individual development programme including executive coaching
- Relocation support if you move to the Nuremberg metropolitan region

Our hiring process
After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will get back to you within ten working days. The process consists of a first video call with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the CFO, a case study that you present to the CFO and two business unit heads, and a final meeting with our Chief Executive Officer at our headquarters. We aim to complete the process within six weeks.

This is a permanent, full-time position based at our headquarters in Nuremberg. We do not consider freelance, interim or temporary agency arrangements for this role.

We welcome applications from all people regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.

What you bring
- A university degree in business administration, economics or a comparable field; a CPA, CMA or similar qualification is a plus
- 10+ years of progressive experience in controlling or FP&A within an international industrial group, of which at least 5 years in a leadership role with disciplinary responsibility
- Deep understanding of group planning, management reporting and business partnering in a multi-entity environment
- Solid knowledge of IFRS and of the link between management and financial reporting
- Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Analytics Cloud or a comparable planning tool
- Experience in the automotive supply industry is a strong advantage
- Business fluent German and English; any further language is a plus
- Willingness to travel around 20 % of your time, mainly within Europe
